newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina authorises YPF staff share sale.
newsitem.headline: Argentina authorises YPF staff share sale.

text.p: Argentine oil giant YPF SA said Friday the government had issued a decree to authorize the flotation of the 10 percent of the company's share capital in the hands of employees.
In a letter to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange, YPF said the decree paves the way for an imminent public offer of the shares to be managed by Salomon Brothers.
YPF obtained the required approval of 90 percent of its employees for the flotation in early June of the 35.5 million C shares in the hands of staff.
